AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VII
Dr. Aron Vale
Sample balloon recovered. Viable EP-7 at seventeen-point-four kilometers. PT-9 association uncertain. We are repeating immediately.
Nobody outside this station gets the preliminary result. Not because I'm hiding it. Because I want to be wrong before I terrify half the planet.
If the association confirms at this altitude, regional models are obsolete. Borders are obsolete. Most surface quarantine assumptions become secondary. The atmosphere becomes the transport network.
I keep thinking about the Pleroma supervisor who once told me logistics made distance irrelevant. He was proud of that. So were all of us. It appears biology has learned the same lesson.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VII
Dr. Aron Vale
Final transmission. Viable EP-7 confirmed above nineteen kilometers. PT-9 association confirmed. Atmospheric circulation is now the primary transport mechanism.
There is no containment perimeter anymore. Stop burning infected regions. Stop bombing infected regions. Stop launching sterilization strikes. You are distributing it.
Shift doctrine from eradication to preservation. Protect clean infrastructure where it still exists. Protect remote populations. Protect food independence. Protect archives. Protect people.
The world cannot be made clean again by destroying larger pieces of it. Please acknowledge. Please acknowledge.
